attributes.scope: MWCC GC 1.2.5 family with the per-TU flags in configure.py

subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: Range trees compare the HIGH bound first (`x < HI && x >= LO`). `!(x < K)` as a final && operand always folds to blt (depth-2 negation included). A one-case switch emits the beq/blt/b triple. `(u32)(x - LO) <= N` is the interval-subtract form. On doubles, `a >= K` guards emit fcmpo + cror(gt,eq) + bne-skip, plain `a < K` is bge, and FP equality uses fcmpu. f64-const equality pairs CSE one lfd across both compares with the constant spelled on the left.
